name: empty
description: A quiet hour: the `created:<1h` search matches nothing. exportEventsJSON streams a literal `[` before the first row and `]` after the last, so zero events is the body `[]`, not an empty body and not an error. This is the most common outcome for an hourly schedule on a small account, so it must not fail -- and it must not POST. An empty delivery is indistinguishable at the receiver from a real batch of nothing, and a receiver that alerts on missing deliveries would be trained by it. requests_absent on every POST is the assertion.

routes.name: account event log, no events in the last hour
